basic_info.description: Beautifully and thoughtfully renovated home with permits filled with natural light!    This charming and sophisticated residence offers a perfect blend of comfort and modern style. The main level features two spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom with skylight, and an inviting open-concept living area complete with a cozy fireplace, dining space, and a stunning kitchen. Enjoy cooking in the beautifully updated kitchen with quartz countertops, new cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances.    Downstairs, the generous primary suite provides a private retreat with its own en suite bathroom ideal for added comfort and privacy. Step outside to a classic yard, perfect for relaxing, entertaining guests, or soaking up the sunshine on warm summer days.    Conveniently located within walking distance to BART and H-Mart. This home offers both comfort and accessibility. Don't miss out, come check it out!!
